description: Read one product video by the id make_product_video answered, or remake_product_video, another_language or other_sizes answered for one: status queued, in_progress, ready or failed. While it is queued or in_progress, call it again about once a minute; ready and failed are final, a failed one with why and whether its credits were refunded. Once ready, it has after_steps, the steps it offers next with their prices in credits. Each ready video's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_product_video again for a new link. An AI UGC video's id is read with get_video. Free.
name: get_product_video
title: A product video
